phase: Product UX and visual development before and during live traffic

current_task.title: Performance and visual stability
current_task.objective: Reduce client overhead, cascade complexity and layout instability while preserving the locked five-viewport product contract.
current_task.next_action: Measure remaining startup/runtime cost before further edits. The lead-form-guard selectedTour MutationObserver cleanup is explicitly deferred: V2TourController exposes public programmatic selectTour(), which mutates selectedTour before v2:tour-selected, so click-only lazy observation would weaken programmatic/error recovery. Keep that observer intact unless a safe pre-mutation lifecycle contract is introduced and proven. Continue with another measured startup/DOM target; do not bundle JS merely to reduce request count.
